name: Trend Micro - Deep Security - Firewall
description: Trend Micro - Deep Security - Firewall offers insights into the last 24 hours of firewall events, including types and reasons, visualized in a timeline column chart. Additionally, provides details on top 5 prevented packets, computers with prevented firewall events, source IDs, destination ports, detected scans, and computers targeted in reconnaissance scans through table charts.
title: Trend Micro - Deep Security - Firewall

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory={{Logsdatasource}}   
| extract "CEF:\s*0\|(?<Device_Vendor>.*)\|(?<Device_Product>.*)\|(?<Device_Version>.*)\|(?<Signature_ID>.*)\|(?<Name>.*)\|(?<Severity>.*)\|(?<Extension>.*)"
| where signature_id >= 850 AND signature_id <= 854
|where if ("{{severity}}" = "*", true, severity matches "{{severity}}") AND if ("{{signature_id}}" = "*", true, signature_id matches "{{signature_id}}") AND if ("{{name}}" = "*", true, name matches "{{name}}")
|count Name 
| top 5 Name by _count

_sourceCategory={{Logsdatasource}}  dst
| extract "CEF:\s*0\|(?<Device_Vendor>.*)\|(?<Device_Product>.*)\|(?<Device_Version>.*)\|(?<Signature_ID>.*)\|(?<Name>.*)\|(?<Severity>.*)\|(?<Extension>.*)" 
| where (signature_id >= 100 AND signature_id <= 199) OR signature_id = 20 OR signature_id = 21 | "Firewall" as deepsecuritysource 
| timeslice 30m
|where if ("{{severity}}" = "*", true, severity matches "{{severity}}") AND if ("{{signature_id}}" = "*", true, signature_id matches "{{signature_id}}") AND if ("{{name}}" = "*", true, name matches "{{name}}")
|count _timeslice, Name | transpose row _timeslice column Name

_sourceCategory={{Logsdatasource}}  dst
| extract "CEF:\s*0\|(?<Device_Vendor>.*)\|(?<Device_Product>.*)\|(?<Device_Version>.*)\|(?<Signature_ID>.*)\|(?<Name>.*)\|(?<Severity>.*)\|(?<Extension>.*)"
| where (signature_id >= 100 AND signature_id <= 199) OR signature_id = 20 OR signature_id = 21
|where if ("{{severity}}" = "*", true, severity matches "{{severity}}") AND if ("{{signature_id}}" = "*", true, signature_id matches "{{signature_id}}") AND if ("{{name}}" = "*", true, name matches "{{name}}")
|count Name 
| top 5 Name by _count

_sourceCategory={{Logsdatasource}}  
| extract "CEF:\s*0\|(?<Device_Vendor>.*)\|(?<Device_Product>.*)\|(?<Device_Version>.*)\|(?<Signature_ID>.*)\|(?<Name>.*)\|(?<Severity>.*)\|(?<Extension>.*)"
| where signature_id >= 850 AND signature_id <= 854
| parse regex field=extension "target=(?<Target_Entity>.+?)\s\w+?=" nodrop
|where if ("{{severity}}" = "*", true, severity matches "{{severity}}") AND if ("{{signature_id}}" = "*", true, signature_id matches "{{signature_id}}") AND if ("{{name}}" = "*", true, name matches "{{name}}")
|count Target_Entity 
| top 5 Target_Entity  by _count

panels.title: Top 5 Destination Ports for Prevented Firewall Events

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory={{Logsdatasource}}  dst
| extract "CEF:\s*0\|(?<Device_Vendor>.*)\|(?<Device_Product>.*)\|(?<Device_Version>.*)\|(?<Signature_ID>.*)\|(?<Name>.*)\|(?<Severity>.*)\|(?<Extension>.*)"
| where (signature_id >= 100 AND signature_id <= 199) OR signature_id = 20 OR signature_id = 21
| parse regex field=extension "dpt=(?<dest_port>.+?)\s\w+?=" nodrop
|where if ("{{severity}}" = "*", true, severity matches "{{severity}}") AND if ("{{signature_id}}" = "*", true, signature_id matches "{{signature_id}}") AND if ("{{name}}" = "*", true, name matches "{{name}}")
|count dest_port 
| top 5 dest_port  by _count

_sourceCategory={{Logsdatasource}}  
| extract "CEF:\s*0\|(?<Device_Vendor>.*)\|(?<Device_Product>.*)\|(?<Device_Version>.*)\|(?<Signature_ID>.*)\|(?<Name>.*)\|(?<Severity>.*)\|(?<Extension>.*)"
| where signature_id >= 850 AND signature_id <= 854
| if (name matches "Reconnaissance Detected: TCP SYNFIN Scan", "TCP SYNFIN Scan", name) as name | if (name matches "Reconnaissance Detected: Computer OS Fingerprint Probe", "Computer OS Fingerprint Probe", name) as name | if (name matches "Reconnaissance Detected: TCP Xmas Scan", "TCP Xmas Scan", name) as name | if (name matches "Reconnaissance Detected: TCP Null Scan", "TCP Null Scan", name) as name | if (name matches "Reconnaissance Detected: Network or Port Scan", "Network or Port Scan", name) as name 
| timeslice 30m
|where if ("{{severity}}" = "*", true, severity matches "{{severity}}") AND if ("{{signature_id}}" = "*", true, signature_id matches "{{signature_id}}") AND if ("{{name}}" = "*", true, name matches "{{name}}")
|count _timeslice, name | transpose row _timeslice column name
